claims.quote: It is an endemic species of southern India, where it is found in the states of Karnataka and Kerala.
Endemic to southern and western parts of India it has been recorded from the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

regions.name: Bharathapuzha
regions.quote: The only specific locality information available states that it was collected from Canara in Karnataka and the Bharathapuzha and Chandragiri rivers in Kerala.
